rev.t: Loyal World Market is much more than just a supermarket; it’s a place where you can shop, grab a meal, and spend a relaxed couple of hours. …

One of my favourite places to go shopping! Incredible quality of veggies and fruits. The baked goods section is also incredible.
Love the collection of imported chocolates and treats too. …

Visited the Market Café inside Loyal World Market at Nexus Whitefield and it turned out to be a great hidden find. The fresh juices are made right in front of you with no syrups and taste really refreshing. I also tried the croissant …
